targets.authors: Wei, Z., Zhang, Y., Clariana, R. B., & Chen, X.
targets.title: The effects of reading prompts and of post-reading generative learning tasks on multiple document integration: Evidence from concept network analysis.
targets.outcome_quote:
In both Study 1 and Study 2 the essay network structural quality of integration for delayed writing three days later (GC
sim
relative to the expert network) was substantially larger in Session 2 (GC
sim
means range from 0.45 to 0.59) than in Session 1 (GC
sim

2024

targets.outcome_reasoning: Both new studies support the original prompt effect on integration quantity, but the authors explicitly contrast improved structural quality at delayed writing with the absence of this increase in Wei et al. (2024). The theoretical support statement concerns the reading purpose effect rather than an overall verdict on every comparison.
